*PRELIMINARIES*

```{r packages, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}

library(ggplot2)
library(lme4)
library(WRS2)
library(knitr)
library(reshape2)
library(plyr)
library(dplyr)
library(stringr)
library(sjPlot)
library(cowplot)
library(fmsb)
library(ggthemes)
library(effects)
library(grid)
library(gridExtra)
library(magick)
library(ggplotify)
library(data.table)
library(tidyr)
library(psych)
library(ggrepel)
library(lmerTest)
library(brms)

```

```{r load data}

setwd("~/Desktop/vizint")
ratings <- read.csv("ratings.csv")
data.v.full <- read.csv("vizint_data.csv")
data.m.full <- read.csv("manint_data.csv")
vizint.task <- ggdraw() + draw_image("vizint_task.png")
manint.task <- ggdraw() + draw_image("man_task.png")

data.v.full <- merge(data.v.full, ratings, by="word")
data.m.full <- merge(data.m.full, ratings, by="word")

data.v.full <- within(data.v.full, exp_cond <- relevel(exp_cond, ref="No_Int"))
data.m.full <- within(data.m.full, exp_cond <- relevel(exp_cond, ref="No_Int"))

# convert duration to ms
data.v.full$duration <- data.v.full$duration * 10
data.m.full$duration <- data.m.full$duration * 10

```

```{r ratings summary}

summary(ratings$viz_win)
summary(ratings$man_win)

ratings %>% 
  summarise(sd_man = sd(man_win), sd_viz = sd(viz_win))

```

*EXPERIMENT 1*

```{r vizint data summary}

v_summary <- data.v.full %>%
  group_by(exp_cond) %>%
  summarise(v_RT_word = mean(RT_WORD), v_RT_shape = mean(RT_SHAPE),
            v_Acc_word = mean(wordAcc), m_Acc_shape = mean(shapeAcc), 
            sd_RT_word = sd(RT_WORD), sd_RT_shape = sd(RT_SHAPE),
            sd_Acc_word = sd(wordAcc), sd_Acc_shape = sd(shapeAcc)) %>%
  na.omit
v_summary

```

This section shows the models testing the effects on word judgment response times.

```{r vizint word RT models}

# a priori models run for exp 1

viz.null <- lmer(RT_WORD ~ 1 + (1+exp_cond|subject) + (1+exp_cond|word), data.v.full, REML=FALSE)
summary(viz.null)

viz.1 <- lmer(RT_WORD ~ exp_cond + duration + conc + logFreq + viz_win + 
                (1+exp_cond|subject) + (1+exp_cond|word), data.v.full, REML=FALSE)
summary(viz.1)

viz.2 <- lmer(RT_WORD ~ exp_cond + duration + conc + logFreq + viz_win +
                (exp_cond:conc) + 
                (1+exp_cond|subject) + (1+exp_cond|word), data.v.full, REML=FALSE)
summary(viz.2)
anova(viz.1, viz.2)

viz.2.1 <- lmer(RT_WORD ~ exp_cond + duration + conc + logFreq + viz_win +
                (exp_cond:viz_win) + 
                (1+exp_cond|subject) + (1+exp_cond|word), data.v.full, REML=FALSE)
summary(viz.2.1)

viz.3 <- lmer(RT_WORD ~ exp_cond + duration + conc + logFreq + viz_win +
                (exp_cond:conc) + (exp_cond:viz_win) + 
                (1+exp_cond|subject) + (1+exp_cond|word),
              data.v.full, REML=FALSE)
summary(viz.3)
anova(viz.2, viz.3)
anova(viz.2.1, viz.3)

# exploratory model ran post exp 2

viz.3.1 <- lmer(RT_WORD ~ exp_cond + duration + conc + logFreq + viz_win + man_win +
                (exp_cond:conc) + (exp_cond:viz_win) + 
                (1+exp_cond|subject) + (1+exp_cond|word), data.v.full, REML=FALSE)
summary(viz.3.1)

viz.4 <- lmer(RT_WORD ~ exp_cond + duration + conc + logFreq + viz_win + man_win +
                (exp_cond:conc) + (exp_cond:viz_win) + (exp_cond:man_win) +
                (1+exp_cond|subject) + (1+exp_cond|word),
              data.v.full, REML=FALSE)
summary(viz.4)

```

```{r std vizint word RT models, eval=FALSE, include=FALSE}

# a priori models run for exp 1

viz.null <- lmer(scale(RT_WORD) ~ 1 + (1+exp_cond|subject) + (1+exp_cond|word), data.v.full, REML=FALSE)
summary(viz.null)

viz.1 <- lmer(scale(RT_WORD) ~ exp_cond + scale(duration) + scale(conc) + scale(logFreq) + scale(viz_win) + 
                (1+exp_cond|subject) + (1+exp_cond|word), data.v.full, REML=FALSE)
summary(viz.1)

viz.2 <- lmer(scale(RT_WORD) ~ exp_cond + scale(duration) + scale(conc) + scale(logFreq) + scale(viz_win) +
                (exp_cond:scale(conc)) + 
                (1+exp_cond|subject) + (1+exp_cond|word), data.v.full, REML=FALSE)
summary(viz.2)
anova(viz.1, viz.2)

viz.2.1 <- lmer(scale(RT_WORD) ~ exp_cond + scale(duration) + scale(conc) + scale(logFreq) + scale(viz_win) +
                (exp_cond:scale(viz_win)) + 
                (1+exp_cond|subject) + (1+exp_cond|word), data.v.full, REML=FALSE)
summary(viz.2.1)

viz.3 <- lmer(scale(RT_WORD) ~ exp_cond + scale(duration) + scale(conc) + scale(logFreq) + scale(viz_win) +
                (exp_cond:scale(conc)) + (exp_cond:scale(viz_win)) + 
                (1+exp_cond|subject) + (1+exp_cond|word),
              data.v.full, REML=FALSE)
summary(viz.3)
anova(viz.2, viz.3)
anova(viz.2.1, viz.3)

# exploratory model ran post exp 2

viz.3.1 <- lmer(scale(RT_WORD) ~ exp_cond + scale(duration) + scale(conc) + scale(logFreq) + 
                scale(viz_win) + scale(man_win) +
                (exp_cond:scale(conc)) + (exp_cond:scale(viz_win)) + 
                (1+exp_cond|subject) + (1+exp_cond|word), data.v.full, REML=FALSE)
summary(viz.3.1)

viz.4 <- lmer(scale(RT_WORD) ~ exp_cond + scale(duration) + scale(conc) + scale(logFreq) + 
                scale(viz_win) + scale(man_win) +
                (exp_cond:scale(conc)) + (exp_cond:scale(viz_win)) + (exp_cond:scale(man_win)) +
                (1+exp_cond|subject) + (1+exp_cond|word),
              data.v.full, REML=FALSE)
summary(viz.4)

```

```{r exp1 bayesian, eval=FALSE, include=FALSE}

V1 <- brm(RT_WORD ~ exp_cond + duration + logFreq + conc + viz_win + man_win +
                (exp_cond:conc) + (exp_cond:viz_win) + (exp_cond:man_win) +
                (1+exp_cond|subject) + (1+exp_cond|word), data=data.v.full)
summary(V1)

V2 <- brm(RT_WORD ~ exp_cond + duration + logFreq + conc + viz_win + man_win +
                (exp_cond:conc) + (exp_cond:viz_win) + (exp_cond:man_win) +
                (scale(conc) + scale(viz_win) + scale(man_win) + scale(conc):exp_cond + scale(viz_win):exp_cond + scale(man_win):exp_cond | subject) + (1+exp_cond|word), 
          data=data.v.full)
summary(V2)

priors1 <- get_prior(RT_WORD ~ exp_cond + duration + logFreq + conc + viz_win + man_win +
                (exp_cond:conc) + (exp_cond:viz_win) + (exp_cond:man_win) +
                (1+exp_cond|subject) + (1+exp_cond|word), data=data.v.full)

priors_exp1 = c(
  set_prior('normal(1000, 20)',class="Intercept"),
  set_prior('normal(100,10)', class='b', coef="exp_condInt"),
  set_prior('normal(20,5)', class='b', coef="duration"),
  set_prior('normal(15,4)', class='b', coef="conc"),
  set_prior('normal(-3,2)', class='b', coef="logFreq"),
  set_prior('normal(5, 3)', class='b', coef="exp_condInt:conc"),
  set_prior('normal(15, 3)', class='b', coef="exp_condInt:viz_win"),
  set_prior('normal(5, 3)', class='b', coef="exp_condInt:man_win")
)

E1 <- brm(RT_WORD ~ exp_cond + duration + logFreq + conc + viz_win + man_win +
                (exp_cond:conc) + (exp_cond:viz_win) + (exp_cond:man_win) +
                (1+exp_cond|subject) + (1+exp_cond|word), data=data.v.full,
          prior=priors_exp1, sample_prior = TRUE, iter=100000, thin=100)
print(summary(E1), digits=5)

E1_int <- brm(RT_WORD ~ exp_cond + duration + logFreq + conc + viz_win + man_win +
                (exp_cond:conc) + (exp_cond:viz_win) + (exp_cond:man_win) +
                (scale(conc) + scale(viz_win) + scale(man_win) + scale(conc):exp_cond + scale(viz_win):exp_cond + scale(man_win):exp_cond | subject) + (1+exp_cond|word), 
          data=data.v.full, prior=priors_exp1, sample_prior = TRUE, iter=100000, thin=100)
print(summary(E1_int), digits=5)

hypothesis(E1, "exp_condInt:viz_win > 0")
hypothesis(E1, "exp_condInt:viz_win = 0")
hypothesis(E1, "exp_condInt:man_win > 0")
hypothesis(E1, "exp_condInt:man_win = 0")
hypothesis(E1, "exp_condInt:viz_win = exp_condInt:man_win")
hypothesis(E1, "exp_condInt:viz_win > exp_condInt:man_win")

hypothesis(E1_int, "exp_condInt:viz_win > 0")
hypothesis(E1_int, "exp_condInt:viz_win = 0")
hypothesis(E1_int, "exp_condInt:man_win > 0")
hypothesis(E1_int, "exp_condInt:man_win = 0")
hypothesis(E1_int, "exp_condInt:viz_win = exp_condInt:man_win")
hypothesis(E1_int, "exp_condInt:viz_win > exp_condInt:man_win")
```

This section shows the models testing the effects on word judgment accuracy.

```{r vizint acc models}

## models do not converge with random slopes
## interaction models do not converge

viz.Acc.1 <- glmer(wordAcc ~ exp_cond + duration + conc + logFreq + viz_win + 
                     (1|subject) + (1|word), data.v.full, binomial)
summary(viz.Acc.1)

viz.Acc.2 <- glmer(wordAcc ~ exp_cond + duration + conc + logFreq + viz_win + 
                     (exp_cond:conc) + 
                     (1|subject) + (1|word), data.v.full, binomial)
summary(viz.Acc.2)

viz.Acc.3 <- glmer(wordAcc ~ exp_cond + duration + conc + logFreq + viz_win + 
                     (exp_cond:conc) + (exp_cond:viz_win) + 
                     (1|subject) + (1|word), data.v.full, binomial)
summary(viz.Acc.3)

anova(viz.Acc.1, viz.Acc.2)
anova(viz.Acc.2, viz.Acc.3)

```

This section shows the models testing the effects on visual task performance.

```{r task models}

data.v.task <- subset(data.v.full, exp_cond=="Int")

viz.task.0 <- lmer(RT_SHAPE ~ 1 + (1|subject) + (1|word), data.v.task, REML=FALSE)
summary(viz.task.0)

viz.task.1 <- lmer(RT_SHAPE ~ duration + conc + logFreq + viz_win + 
                     (1|subject) + (1|word), data.v.task, REML=FALSE)
summary(viz.task.1)


viz.taskAcc.0 <- glmer(shapeAcc ~ 1 + (1|subject) + (1|word), data.v.task, binomial)
summary(viz.taskAcc.0)

viz.taskAcc.1 <- glmer(shapeAcc ~ duration + conc + logFreq + viz_win + 
                         (1|subject) + (1|word), data.v.task, binomial)
summary(viz.taskAcc.1)

```

viz.acc.tab <- cbind(est=fixef(viz.Acc.1),viz.acc.CI)

```{r vizint plots}

viz.ratings.plot.dat <- with(data.v.full, aggregate(list(RT_WORD, wordAcc, viz_win, man_win, 
                                                         resid_viz, resid_man, conc, logFreq, duration), 
                                                    list(word, exp_cond), 
                                                    mean, na.rm=TRUE))
colnames(viz.ratings.plot.dat) <- c("word", "exp_cond", "RT_WORD", "wordAcc", "viz_win", "man_win", 
                                    "resid_viz", "resid_man", "conc", "logFreq", "duration")

viz.int.melt <- melt(viz.ratings.plot.dat, id.vars=c("word", "exp_cond"))
viz.int.cast <- dcast(viz.int.melt, word ~ exp_cond + variable)
colnames(viz.int.cast) <- c("word", "noInt_RT", "noInt_Acc", "viz_win", "man_win", 
                            "resid_viz", "resid_man", "conc", "logFreq", "duration",
                            "Int_RT", "Int_Acc", "viz_win2", "man_win2", 
                            "resid_viz2", "resid_man2", "conc2", "logFreq2", "duration2")
viz.int.cast$IntEff <-  viz.int.cast$Int_RT - viz.int.cast$noInt_RT

# plots

viz.ratings.plot <- ggplot(viz.int.cast, aes(x=viz_win, y=IntEff)) +
  geom_point(size=.2, alpha=.2) +
  geom_text_repel(label=viz.int.cast$word, size=2, segment.color = NA) +
  geom_smooth(color="purple", method="lm") +
  labs(x="Scaled Visual Rating", y="Visual Task Interference Effect (in ms)") +
  theme_few()
viz.ratings.plot

fig1 <- plot_grid(vizint.task, viz.ratings.plot, nrow=1, labels=c("A","B"))
fig1

```

```{r manint plots}

man.ratings.plot.dat <- with(data.m.full, aggregate(list(RT_WORD, wordAcc, man_win, viz_win,
                                                         resid_viz, resid_man, logFreq, conc, duration), 
                                                    list(word, exp_cond), 
                                                    mean, na.rm=TRUE))
colnames(man.ratings.plot.dat) <- c("word", "exp_cond", "RT_WORD", "wordAcc", "man_win", "viz_win", 
                                    "resid_viz", "resid_man", "logFreq", "conc", "duration")

man.int.melt <- melt(man.ratings.plot.dat, id.vars=c("word", "exp_cond"))
man.int.cast <- dcast(man.int.melt, word ~ exp_cond + variable)
colnames(man.int.cast) <- c("word", "noInt_RT", "noInt_Acc", 
                            "man_win", "viz_win", "resid_viz", "resid_man", "logFreq", "conc", "duration",
                            "Int_RT", "Int_Acc",
                            "man_win2", "viz_win2", "resid_viz2", "resid_man2", "logFreq2", "conc2", "duration2")
man.int.cast$IntEff <-  man.int.cast$Int_RT - man.int.cast$noInt_RT

# plots

man.ratings.plot <- ggplot(man.int.cast, aes(x=man_win, y=IntEff)) +
  geom_point(size=.2, alpha=.2) +
  geom_text_repel(label=man.int.cast$word, size=2, segment.color = NA) +
  geom_smooth(color="purple", method="lm") +
  labs(x="Scaled Manual Rating", y="Manual Task Interference Effect (in ms)") +
  theme_few()
man.ratings.plot

cont.ratings.plot <- ggplot(man.int.cast, aes(x=scale(viz_win), y=IntEff)) +
  geom_point(size=.2, alpha=.2) +
  geom_text_repel(label=man.int.cast$word, size=2, segment.color = NA) +
  geom_smooth(color="purple", method="lm") +
  labs(x="Scaled Visual Rating", y="Manual Task Interference Effect (in ms)") +
  theme_few()
cont.ratings.plot

fig2a <- plot_grid(NULL, manint.task, NULL, nrow=1, labels=c("", "A", ""))
fig2a
fig2b <- plot_grid(cont.ratings.plot, man.ratings.plot, nrow = 1, labels=c("B", "C"))
fig2b
fig2 <- plot_grid(fig2a, fig2b, nrow=2, rel_heights = c(0.5, 1))
fig2

# correlations to superimpose on plots

cor.test(viz.int.cast$viz_win, viz.int.cast$IntEff)
cor.test(viz.int.cast$man_win, viz.int.cast$IntEff)

cor.test(man.int.cast$man_win, man.int.cast$IntEff)
cor.test(man.int.cast$viz_win, man.int.cast$IntEff)

```

```{r viz bayesian, eval=FALSE, include=FALSE}

#this chunk will test whether the effect of visual experience is greater on visual than manual int

# first need to create df for both exps combined

viz.int.cast$exp <- "viz"
man.int.cast$exp <- "man"

data.cast.full <- rbind(viz.int.cast, man.int.cast)

V_mod <- brm(IntEff ~ exp + duration + logFreq + conc + viz_win + man_win +
                (exp:conc) + (exp:viz_win) + (exp:man_win), 
         data=data.cast.full)
summary(V_mod)

priors_V = c(
  set_prior('normal(100, 20)',class="Intercept"),
  set_prior('normal(50,30)', coef="expviz"),
  set_prior('normal(0,1)', coef="duration"),
  set_prior('normal(-3,2)', coef="conc"),
  set_prior('normal(0,1)', coef="logFreq"),
  set_prior('normal(0, 1)', class='b', coef="expviz:conc"),
  set_prior('normal(10, 3)', coef="expviz:viz_win"),
  set_prior('normal(-10, 3)', coef="expviz:man_win")
)

V <- brm(IntEff ~ exp + duration + logFreq + conc + viz_win + man_win +
                (exp:conc) + (exp:viz_win) + (exp:man_win), 
         data=data.cast.full, prior=priors_V, sample_prior = TRUE, iter=100000, thin=100)
summary(V)

hypothesis(V, "expviz:viz_win > 0")
hypothesis(V, "expviz:viz_win = 0")
hypothesis(V, "expviz:man_win < 0")
hypothesis(V, "expviz:man_win = 0")

```
